Name: Craft Anything
Author: SaberaMesia
Description:
For detailed instructions about how to use Craft Anything in your mod, please see [url=https://github.com/ebehar/CraftAnything]the README in the GitHub repository.[/url]﻿

If you have a mod which requires Craft Anything, just install it into your Stardew Valley mods folder like any other SMAPI mod, and you're good to go!

Please note that Craft Anything is NOT COMPATIBLE with BetterCrafting, and it's not clear to me that they could be made to work together until SMAPI 3.0 comes out!
